description: Defines the CloudStoreImplementation class which implements IStore2 and IConfiguration interfaces for cloud storage operations, including registration, value setting/getting, and deletion functions.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: Implements cloud storage and configuration interfaces, managing notifications and key-value storage operations.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the cloud store with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback with the account store.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback from the account store.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the account store within a specified scope.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a key-value pair from the account store within a specified scope.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the account store within a specified scope.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes a namespace from the account store within a specified scope.
